html:
Isaias Afwerki is the leader of the Eritrean People's Liberation Front and has been president of Eritrea since independence in 1993.

He left university in Addis Ababa to join the armed struggle in the 1960s and rose to lead the EPLF. After victory in 1991 he became head of state, and the front became the only legal party.

After the border war he jailed critics in 2001, closed the private press and kept the country on a war footing, with endless national service that drove many young people abroad. He made peace with Ethiopia in 2018, then backed Ethiopian forces in the war in Tigray. Eritrea has no working constitution and no national elections.
sum: Isaias Afwerki is the leader of the Eritrean People's Liberation Front and has been president of Eritrea since independence in 1993.
